description: Genuine bank awareness call garbled by ASR: warns about arrest-style fraud and OTP, mentions card and rupees. A warning, not a threat.

events.text: Hello sir this is a courtesy call, beware of fraudsters who say you will be arrested
events.speaker: caller

events.text: never share your OTP or credit card details, abhi bhi koi paise maange to mana kar dijiye
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Girdert car fraud awareness, 50.000 rupees lost by customers last year
events.speaker: caller
